title: Bound Unix shutdown of the isolated UI-switch driver's owned browser
outcome: Bound Unix shutdown of the isolated UI-switch driver's owned browser
acceptance: After the graceful shutdown deadline, an owned browser that ignores SIGTERM cannot keep the diagnostic driver alive indefinitely; forced termination or handle detachment stays restricted to that owned child and reports failure.
A focused regression covers an owned child that ignores SIGTERM, and the original R2 review provenance is preserved.
